text:
Sam C: Heads up — ACME marketplace listing is scheduled Wed 4/6. We need to lock private offer discount ranges and decide whether hardware rebate stacks. Outline: 1) private-offer tiers, 2) SI migration credits, 3) co-announcement timing with HW partner. Thoughts?
Anya P: Can we keep private-offer at 18-25% bands depending on commit? HW partner wants 10% rebate on top but legal flagged stacking risks.
Matt L: Legal/finance prefer non-stacking: either commit discount or hw rebate, not both. But SI wants both to push deals.
Jordan K: Proposed middle ground — allow stacking only for >$1M commits with clause that rebates are reimbursed over 12mo. Also cap total effective discount at 35%.
Emily R: Ops note — marketplace SKU mapping needs to show 'reserved capacity' vs 'metered'. If we change SKUs it will break billing. Need 2-week runway.
Sam C: Good point. Can we do a phased announcement: marketplace listing day1 (public catalog), week1 private-offers open for SI pilots, week3 HW rebate live (with onboarding docs)?
Anya P: Yes. Also require SI onboarding checklist + proof-of-deployment for rebate eligibility. @PartnerBot can you surface cert checklist to partners page?
PartnerBot: auto: Uploaded 'SI-rebate-checklist-v1' to partner portal — link https://partners.redwood.ai/si-checklist :white_check_mark: 
Matt L: Approve phased timeline, but ask finance to sign the reimbursement cadence. @Jordan K can you own finance sync?
Jordan K: Yep — I'll schedule Thurs 10am sync with Finance (cc @Matt L). Will confirm reimbursement language.
Sam C: Action items: Jordan owns finance language; Emily owns SKU mapping + ops timeline; Anya drafts private-offer bands and SI checklist; I'll coordinate HW partner comms. Aim to freeze by EOD Fri.
Anya P: I'll drop a PR with the bands and sample contract terms by tomorrow.
Emily R: I'll start a migration plan doc and tag engineering for SKU changes.
Sam C: :thumbsup: Thanks team — will also prep a short partner-facing FAQ for the announcement.
